submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 with iterative topological clustering and learned calibration at a threshold of 34.2 GeV achieves the highest signal efficiency of 94.269% at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate. This represents a significant improvement over Algorithm-L3 (best: 85.948% at 30 GeV) and Algorithm-L1 (best: 75.508% at 35 GeV). The threshold of 34.2 GeV was optimized through systematic scanning and represents the peak efficiency for this algorithm within the allowed 20-60 GeV range. All candidate algorithms fit within the FPGA resource budget as documented, and the successful simulation confirms technical feasibility including the latency constraint.
